samples.question: 哪个科室接诊的不同病人数量最多？
samples.sql: SELECT department FROM patient_visits GROUP BY department ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT patient_id) DESC LIMIT 1

samples.question: 开具过阿司匹林肠溶片的病人平均年龄是多少？
samples.sql: SELECT AVG(v.age) FROM patient_visits v JOIN prescriptions p ON v.visit_id = p.visit_id WHERE p.drug = '阿司匹林肠溶片'

samples.question: 住院花费高于全院平均花费的就诊有多少次？
samples.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM patient_visits WHERE cost > (SELECT AVG(cost) FROM patient_visits)

samples.question: 男性强直性脊柱炎患者的总花费是多少？
samples.sql: SELECT SUM(cost) FROM patient_visits WHERE gender = '男' AND disease = '强直性脊柱炎'

samples.question: 被开具总天数最多的是哪种药？
samples.sql: SELECT drug FROM prescriptions GROUP BY drug ORDER BY SUM(days) DESC LIMIT 1

samples.question: 检验结果异常的就诊里，最常见的疾病是哪个？
samples.sql: SELECT v.disease FROM patient_visits v JOIN lab_tests t ON v.visit_id = t.visit_id WHERE t.abnormal = 1 GROUP BY v.disease ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT v.visit_id) DESC LIMIT 1

samples.question: 六十岁以上高血压患者的平均住院费用是多少？
samples.sql: SELECT AVG(cost) FROM patient_visits WHERE age > 60 AND disease = '高血压'

samples.question: 每种性别分别有多少个不同的病人？
samples.sql: SELECT gender, COUNT(DISTINCT patient_id) FROM patient_visits GROUP BY gender

samples.question: 开药天数超过七天的处方一共涉及多少种不同的药？
samples.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT drug) FROM prescriptions WHERE days > 7

samples.question: 接诊高血压病人最多的前三个科室是哪些？
samples.sql: SELECT department FROM patient_visits WHERE disease = '高血压' GROUP BY department ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 3

samples.question: 花费最高的那次就诊对应的是什么疾病？
samples.sql: SELECT disease FROM patient_visits ORDER BY cost DESC LIMIT 1

samples.question: 冠心病患者一共用过哪些不同的药物？
samples.sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.drug FROM prescriptions p JOIN patient_visits v ON p.visit_id = v.visit_id WHERE v.disease = '冠心病'

samples.question: 各疾病的平均就诊年龄是多少，按平均年龄从高到低排列？
samples.sql: SELECT disease, AVG(age) AS a FROM patient_visits GROUP BY disease ORDER BY a DESC

samples.question: 做过两种及以上不同检验项目的就诊有多少次？
samples.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT visit_id FROM lab_tests GROUP BY visit_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT test_name) >= 2)

samples.question: 五十岁以下的患者一共有多少人次？
samples.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM patient_visits WHERE age < 50

samples.question: 强直性脊柱炎患者中年龄超过七十岁的有几次就诊？
samples.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM patient_visits WHERE disease='强直性脊柱炎' AND age > 70

samples.question: 就诊人次第二多的疾病是什么？
samples.sql: SELECT disease FROM patient_visits GROUP BY disease ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1

samples.question: 高血压病患者一共有多少位不同的病人？
samples.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT patient_id) FROM patient_visits WHERE disease='高血压'

samples.question: 心梗患者的平均住院费用是多少？
samples.sql: SELECT AVG(cost) FROM patient_visits WHERE disease='急性心肌梗死'

samples.question: 糖肾患者用过哪些不同的药物？
samples.sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.drug FROM prescriptions p JOIN patient_visits v ON p.visit_id=v.visit_id WHERE v.disease='糖尿病肾病'

samples.question: 平均就诊费用最低的科室是哪个？
samples.sql: SELECT department FROM patient_visits GROUP BY department ORDER BY AVG(cost) ASC LIMIT 1

samples.question: 30到50岁之间的患者有多少次就诊？
samples.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM patient_visits WHERE age BETWEEN 30 AND 50

samples.question: 女性患者占总就诊人次的比例是多少？
samples.sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN gender='女' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL)/COUNT(*) FROM patient_visits

samples.question: 开具过两种及以上不同药物的就诊有多少次？
samples.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT visit_id FROM prescriptions GROUP BY visit_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT drug) >= 2)

samples.question: 除了内科以外，就诊人次最多的科室是哪个？
samples.sql: SELECT department FROM patient_visits WHERE department != '内科' GROUP BY department ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

samples.question: 2024年哪个月的就诊量最高？
samples.sql: SELECT substr(visit_date,1,7) AS m FROM patient_visits GROUP BY m ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

samples.question: 2024年3月的就诊量是多少？
samples.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM patient_visits WHERE substr(visit_date,1,7)='2024-03'

samples.question: 做过检验但结果都正常的就诊有多少次？
samples.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM patient_visits v WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM lab_tests t WHERE t.visit_id=v.visit_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM lab_tests t WHERE t.visit_id=v.visit_id AND t.abnormal=1)

samples.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT drug) FROM prescriptions

samples.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM patient_visits WHERE disease='高血压' AND substr(visit_date,1,7) BETWEEN '2024-01' AND '2024-06'

samples.sql: SELECT AVG(p.days) FROM prescriptions p JOIN patient_visits v ON p.visit_id=v.visit_id WHERE v.disease='强直性脊柱炎'

samples.question: 每个科室各接诊了多少位不同的病人？
samples.sql: SELECT department, COUNT(DISTINCT patient_id) AS n FROM patient_visits GROUP BY department ORDER BY n DESC
